Contract ManageCashierCRUDService::deleteCashier(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashier: Cashier = Cashier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		cashier.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newCashier: Cashier in
		newCashier.oclIsNew() and
		Store.allInstance()->includes(newCashier) and
		result = true
}
